# Tantra

> Tantra is an omnichannel outreach engine. It runs ordered sequences across Gmail, LinkedIn, WhatsApp and Telegram — including social-only sequences — plus Google Calendar campaigns measured by RSVP, with every reply landing in one unified inbox.

Gmail sequence steps and Google Calendar campaigns send through the customer's own Google Workspace service account with domain-wide delegation, so they go out from their real mailboxes rather than a shared pool.
LinkedIn, WhatsApp and Telegram steps send through the customer's own linked social accounts. Google Workspace is required only for Gmail or Calendar, so a social-only sequence needs no Workspace tenant.
All three social channels are included in the Pro plan — pricing is per company rather than per inbox, per seat, or per channel.
AI personalization is optional and runs on the customer's own LLM API key (OpenRouter, Cerebras or Novita); there are no resold AI credits. Templates, merge tags and spintax work without any AI provider, and social messages are template-based.
There is deliberately no open-pixel tracking. Engagement is measured by clicks on signed links, replies and calendar RSVPs.
Webinar attendance syncs from Zoom and WebinarGeek for follow-up attribution, as an add-on path for teams that fill events with outreach.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/): Product overview: the engine, the channels, and the add-on paths
- [Omnichannel Sequences](https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/sequences): Ordered Gmail, LinkedIn, WhatsApp and Telegram steps in one flow
- [Unified Inbox](https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/inbox): Every reply, every channel, one queue with intent classification
- [Deliverability](https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/deliverability): Warmup, validation, suppression, pacing — and no open pixels
- [AI Personalization](https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/ai): Bring-your-own-key personalization with template fallback
- [Developer Platform](https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/developers): Webhooks, REST API, and the MCP server
- [Calendar Campaigns](https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/calendar-campaigns): Google Calendar invitations at scale, measured by RSVP
- [Webinar Attribution](https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/webinars): Zoom and WebinarGeek attribution from invite to watch time
- [Pricing](https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/pricing): Per-company plans, what is never metered, and billing FAQ
- [Integrations](https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/integrations): Channels, webinar providers, AI providers, and developer surfaces
- [Help Center](https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/help): Task-oriented documentation, organised by topic
- [Blog](https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/blog): Long-form guides on deliverability and outreach strategy
- [Contact](https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/contact-us): Demo requests, sales and support

## Documentation

- [Getting Started](https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/help/getting-started): What Tantra is, which outreach channels you can use, and how to run your first campaign.
- [Connect Google Workspace](https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/help/connect-google-workspace): Set up the Google service account and domain-wide delegation that lets Tantra send as your mailboxes.
- [Calendar Campaigns](https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/help/calendar-campaigns): Reach prospects with Google Calendar invitations and track their RSVPs.
- [Cold Email](https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/help/cold-email): Build multi-step email sequences that send from your mailboxes with per-sender limits.
- [Multichannel Outreach](https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/help/multichannel-outreach): Connect LinkedIn, WhatsApp, and Telegram, then add those channels to your outreach sequences.
- [Inbox and Replies](https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/help/inbox-and-replies): Read replies across your outreach channels and keep conversations organized.
- [Contacts and Lists](https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/help/contacts): Import, organize, validate, and suppress contacts across your campaigns.
- [Templates and AI](https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/help/templates-and-ai): Reusable templates, merge tags, spintax, AI personalization, and connecting your own LLM.
- [Deliverability and Tracking](https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/help/deliverability-and-tracking): Click tracking, custom domains, one-click unsubscribe, domain health, and why opens are not tracked.
- [Integrations](https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/help/integrations): Connect Google Calendar accounts, WebinarGeek, and Google OAuth client credentials.
- [API, MCP, and Webhooks](https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/help/api-and-mcp): Issue API keys, connect the Tantra MCP server to Claude or Cursor, and receive outbound webhooks.
- [Billing](https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/help/billing): Choose a plan, manage your subscription, and control channel add-ons.
- [Troubleshooting](https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/help/troubleshooting): Fix the most common issues across sending, personalization, and connections.
- [Glossary](https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/help/glossary): Plain-language definitions of the terms Tantra uses.
